notes.title: Better than never.
notes.content:
Hello! 
I delayed the posting of this news until the various items became available for Steam, and now the moment has come.
First of all, updating the game. A small patch that unlocks access to the Chronos Game after completing the game in the "Real Finale".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/6f1ae1e7c79c898cd67640177c591dac269a2d29.jpg 

This is a new room in the Union, where the conditions of the game change a little, and you have to play with a time limit, collecting hourglasses from clients.
The more hourglasses collected, the higher the player is on the leaderboard. In the leaderboard available in this room, you can see the nicknames of the five leaders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/b0f65017e0944fa20aeb17a2c3410f0b68d5c185.jpg 

 The second thing I want to report. 
Cards, badges, avatars, backgrounds and emoticons for Steam profiles are now available.
There are only five cards, these are four Horsemen and one Reaper.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/adf4dc737704f5c22a72794a72c4d004fed8404c.jpg 

 Badges 
From the cards, as is usual, you can collect badges. No wonder our badges are skulls. Shattered Skull is awarded as a collection of metal cards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/d0d30d27588072ca03315141a9ad7d2275a54bb6.png 

 Emoticons, several emoticons. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/4773633598a1baa929084f3640420a3e1e3db609.png 

 Examples of animated avatar borders and avatars. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/cc103902e9c285b35a61716c1659460216b3b725.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/9c9f10abb87825a66b06952a381aa4a3fea4377f.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/70d96fabc512086663c5d5c610cd85567b9ab675.gif

 One of the backgrounds. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/d25cffa914dbbdaac3b0c5bbed1ad064a10aa3f1.jpg 

 Third, but also interesting. 
The game is available for purchase on Google Play. If you enter the name of the game "Peace, Death! 2" into the Play Market search, you will easily find it.

  That's all for now, thank you for your attention. Play!

notes.title: War and Famine do not humiliate anymore!
notes.content:
Hello!
First, thanks for the warm welcome of the game and great reviews.
Secondly, even in great reviews, there are often complaints about the tasks of War and Famine.
Less than a year later, here it is, a small patch that changes the situation.

1. During the War's Quest, there is a 100% chance that the stage will have enough weapons to complete the quest. There is no guarantee that the weapon will appear in place of the cart. Otherwise, what is the point?

2. During the Famine's Quest, there is a 100% chance that each required food will appear at least once during the level. Previously it was not, but now it is.

Other changes, no less important.
3. The Knight in the Union has changed his position.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/aad864b34d67fe66d56f38edfcbb9888913df913.jpg

4. In the Union, there may be FPS drop due to something hidden.

5. There were some imperfections on the Mistake! page: the Jinn and the Croupier did not show their signs around them, the Parasite, when sent, did not show a connection with its victim. Now everyone is showing everything.

6. [strike]I hope this will not happen, but any critical errors are always possible.[/strike]

notes.title: Peace, Death! 2 - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The game is finally out. Phew.

In a place beyond time and space, the Reapers formed an independent Union so they wouldn't have to answer to the Horsemen of the Apocalypse anymore.
With no acceptable candidate for the position of Union leader, the atmosphere at the Union has descended into blissful anarchy, which is not great for productivity.
Fortunately, a new Reaper gets hired as a Sorter one day - you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546790/Peace_Death_2

notes.title: CATASTROPHES!
notes.content:
Yo, my Reapers. We are done with new Catastrophes in Peace, Death! 2 and here's some news aboot Catastrophes v.2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/a235f01ea2d83b8142adb387a57290a7d73a29ec.gif

1. First of all, Catastrophes now is all about Undead, new type of clients. They are similar to Neutrals (human etc.), but can't speak. Because you do not want to read when timer is ticking!
2. *Catastrophes are optional. A bit optional. I mean, sometimes you can decide when to start the encounter, sooner or later. 
3. Clients sent during a catastrophe are counted towards the total score only when the catastrophe is completed. This can be both helpful and frustrating. Great! No! Huh?
4. All catastrophes have a difficulty level. After each successful completion of a catastrophe, its difficulty increases.
5. You will be able to CHOOSE which of the catastrophes occurs on the next level.
6. By completing catastrophes, you help the Knight defeat the Undead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39830876/6c4aed29a1aeb83f742980c4083a1e98ea07a7a8.png
